pr_title: store/tikv: pipe the split and scatter task
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: nolouch <nolouch@gmail.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/22969

Problem Summary:
Splitting and Scattering at the same time will cause multiple conflicts on the same region.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6428910/111289009-af99e880-867f-11eb-99e6-d441a3b2acf3.png)


### What is changed and how it works?

pipeline all splits task and scatter tasks


### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- Make the time consuming of `split table` more stable 
```
I have run multiple times  to split 4000 regions, and the time is stale about `1m30s`
2021/03/17 17:25:57 split single sql result: [map[SCATTER_FINISH_RATIO:1 TOTAL_SPLIT_REGION:2001]]
2021/03/17 17:25:57 split all sql run total cost: 1m28.908304306s
2021/03/17 17:25:57 split all sql run success!!!

```

issue_context.title: Make the time consuming of `split table` more stable
issue_context.body:
## Development Task
Because split and scatter tasks are asynchronous, and currently the batch size is too small (after https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/18191)
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/d94920e4a9aca4dfae856ca12835b7ef52a66bf6/store/tikv/split_region.go#L34-L36
which causes many split and scatter tasks at times, which have two problems:
- at the same time will cause multiple conflicts on the same region, and then report epoch not match, we need more time to retry.
   ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6428910/111449414-58147f00-874a-11eb-891a-96991ecc0498.png)

   
- it is very likely to cause a split from a scattering region, resulting in many 4 replicas regions, which will lead to the time-consuming of `split table` be unstable. We need to ensure that all regions that need to be broken up are split at once and then scatter at once.

I mean https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/22788 .
OK, I'm off topic.
The current region scatter may not work in a specific case which described in https://github.com/tikv/pd/pull/3422 ,  I think it's not related to the api.
